verses.text: Rehoboam go Shechem, because all Israel don come to Shechem to make am king.
E happen say as Jeroboam, Nebat pikin, hear am, e still dey Egypt, wia e run go from King Solomon face, so Jeroboam return from Egypt.
Dem send call am. Jeroboam and all Israel come and talk to Rehoboam say,
“Your papa make our yoke heavy. So now make your papa hard work and im heavy yoke wey e put on us light small, and we go serve you.”
E talk to dem say, “Come back to me after three days.” Di people go.
King Rehoboam ask di old men wey dey stand before im papa Solomon as e still dey alive for advice, say, “Wetin una advise make I answer dis people?”
Dem talk to am say, “If you dey kind to dis people and make dem happy and talk good words to dem, den dem go be your servants forever.”
But e leave di advice of di old men wey dem give am, and ask di young men wey grow up with am, wey dey stand before am.
E talk to dem say, “Wetin una advise say make we answer dis people wey talk to me say, ‘Make di yoke wey your papa put on us light small’?”

Di young men wey grow up with am talk to am say, “Na so you go tell di people wey talk to you say, ‘Your papa make our yoke heavy, but make am light for us.’ Na so you go tell dem, ‘My small finger thick pass my papa waist.
Now as my papa put heavy yoke on una, I go add to una yoke. My papa beat una with whips, but I go beat una with scorpions.’”
So Jeroboam and all di people come to Rehoboam di third day, as di king talk say, “Come back to me di third day.”
Di king answer dem hard, and King Rehoboam leave di advice of di old men,
and talk to dem as di advice of di young men be, say, “My papa make una yoke heavy, but I go add to am. My papa beat una with whips, but I go beat una with scorpions.”
So di king no listen to di people, because na God arrange am, so that di Lord go make im word stand, wey e talk by Ahijah di Shilonite to Jeroboam, Nebat pikin.

As all Israel see say di king no listen to dem, di people answer di king say, “Wetin be our share for David? We no get inheritance for Jesse pikin. Go your tents, Israel! Now look after your own house, David.” So all Israel go dem tents.
But as for Israel pikin dem wey dey stay for Judah cities, Rehoboam rule over dem.
Den King Rehoboam send Hadoram, wey dey over di men wey dey do forced work, and Israel pikin dem stone am to death with stones. King Rehoboam hurry climb im chariot to run go Jerusalem.
So Israel rebel against David house till today.
As Rehoboam reach Jerusalem, e gather Judah house and Benjamin, 180,000 chosen men wey be warriors, to fight against Israel, to bring di kingdom back to Rehoboam.
But di word of di Lord come to Shemaiah, di man of God, say,
“Talk to Rehoboam, Solomon pikin, king of Judah, and to all Israel for Judah and Benjamin say,

‘Dis na wetin di Lord talk: “Una no go go up or fight against una brothers. Make every man return to im house, because dis thing na from me.”’” So dem listen to di word of di Lord and return from going against Jeroboam.
Rehoboam dey stay for Jerusalem and build strong cities for Judah.
E build Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa,
Beth Zur, Soco, Adullam,
Gath, Mareshah, Ziph,
Adoraim, Lachish, Azekah,
Zorah, Aijalon and Hebron, wey dey Judah and Benjamin, strong cities.
E make di strong places strong, put captains inside dem and store food, oil and wine.
For every city e put shields and spears, and make dem very strong. Judah and Benjamin belong to am.
Di priests and di Levites wey dey all Israel come meet am from all dem borders.
Because di Levites leave dem grazing land and dem possessions and come Judah and Jerusalem, because Jeroboam and im pikin dem reject dem so that dem no go do di priest work for di Lord,
and e appoint priests for imself for di high places, and for di goat idols and for di calves wey e make.
After dem, from all di tribes of Israel, dem wey set dem heart to look for di Lord, di God of Israel, come Jerusalem to make sacrifice to di Lord, di God of dem papa dem.
So dem make di kingdom of Judah strong and make Rehoboam, Solomon pikin, strong three years, because dem waka for di way of David and Solomon three years.
Rehoboam marry Mahalath as wife, Jerimoth daughter, David pikin, and Abihail, Eliab daughter, Jesse pikin.
E born pikin dem for am: Jeush, Shemariah and Zaham.
After am e marry Maacah, Absalom daughter, and e born Abijah, Attai, Ziza and Shelomith for am.
Rehoboam love Maacah, Absalom daughter, pass all im wives and concubines, because e marry 18 wives and 60 concubines, and e born 28 sons and 60 daughters.
Rehoboam appoint Abijah, Maacah pikin, to be chief and ruler among im brothers, because e wan make am king.
E act wisely and scatter some of all im pikin dem all over Judah and Benjamin, to every strong city, and e give dem plenty food. E look for many wives for dem.
As Rehoboam kingdom stand and e become strong, e leave di law of di Lord, and all Israel with am.
For di fifth year of King Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt come up against Jerusalem, because dem don sin against di Lord,
with 1,200 chariots and 60,000 horsemen. Di people wey come with am from Egypt no get number: di Lubim, di Sukkiim and di Ethiopians.
E take di strong cities of Judah and come Jerusalem.

Den Shemaiah di prophet come to Rehoboam and to di princes of Judah wey gather for Jerusalem because of Shishak, and talk to dem say, “Dis na wetin di Lord talk: ‘Una don leave me, so I don leave una for Shishak hand too.’”
Den di princes of Israel and di king humble demselves and talk say, “Di Lord dey righteous.”

As di Lord see say dem humble demselves, di word of di Lord come to Shemaiah say, “Dem don humble demselves. I no go destroy dem, but I go give dem small deliverance, and my anger no go pour on Jerusalem by Shishak hand.
Still, dem go be im servants, so that dem go know my service and di service of di kingdoms of di countries.”

So Shishak king of Egypt come up against Jerusalem and carry away di treasures of di Lord house and di treasures of di king house. E carry everything, and e carry di gold shields wey Solomon make too.
King Rehoboam make bronze shields for dem place and give dem to di captains of di guard, wey dey guard di door of di king house.
E happen say any time di king go enter di Lord house, di guards go carry dem and bring dem back enter di guard room.
As e humble imself, di anger of di Lord turn from am, so e no destroy am completely, and good things dey for Judah too.

So King Rehoboam make imself strong for Jerusalem and rule. Rehoboam be 41 years old as e begin to rule, and e rule 17 years for Jerusalem, di city wey di Lord choose from all di tribes of Israel to put im name there. Im mama name na Naamah, one Ammon woman.
E do wetin bad, because e no set im heart to look for di Lord.

Di rest of wetin Rehoboam do, from first to last, dem no write dem for di histories of Shemaiah di prophet and of Iddo di seer, as dem dey write genealogies? War dey between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all di time.
Rehoboam die join im papa dem and dem bury am for David city, and im pikin Abijah rule for im place.
For di 18th year of King Jeroboam, Abijah begin to rule over Judah.
E rule three years for Jerusalem. Im mama name na Micaiah, Uriel daughter, from Gibeah. War dey between Abijah and Jeroboam.
Abijah begin battle with army of brave men of war, even 400,000 chosen men, and Jeroboam arrange battle against am with 800,000 chosen men, wey be brave and mighty men.
Abijah stand up on Mount Zemaraim, wey dey Ephraim hill country, and talk say, “Hear me, Jeroboam and all Israel.
Una no suppose know say di Lord, di God of Israel, give David di kingdom over Israel forever, even to am and to im pikin dem by covenant of salt?
Still, Jeroboam, Nebat pikin, wey be servant of Solomon, David pikin, rise up and rebel against im oga.
Useless men and wicked men gather to am, and dem make demselves strong against Rehoboam, Solomon pikin, as Rehoboam still dey young and soft for heart, and e no fit stand against dem.
“Now una think say una go fit stand against di kingdom of di Lord for David pikin dem hand, and una be big crowd, and di gold calves wey Jeroboam make for una as gods dey with una.

Una no don drive out di priests of di Lord, Aaron pikin dem, and di Levites, and make priests for una self like di people of di other lands dey do? Anybody wey come to give imself with young bull and seven rams, even am fit be priest of dem wey no be gods.
“But as for us, di Lord na our God, and we no leave am. We get priests wey dey serve di Lord, Aaron pikin dem, and di Levites for dem work,

and dem dey burn burnt sacrifice and sweet incense to di Lord every morning and every evening. Dem dey arrange di bread of di presence for di clean table, and di gold lampstand with im lamps, to burn every evening, because we dey keep di charge of di Lord our God, but una don leave am.
Look, God dey with us as our head, and im priests with di trumpets to sound alarm against una. Israel pikin dem, no fight against di Lord, di God of una papa dem, because una no go prosper.”
But Jeroboam arrange ambush to come from behind dem, so dem dey before Judah and di ambush dey behind dem.
As Judah look back, look, di battle dey before and behind dem, and dem cry to di Lord, and di priests blow di trumpets.
Den di men of Judah shout, and as di men of Judah shout, God strike Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.
Israel pikin dem run before Judah, and God give dem into dem hand.
Abijah and im people kill dem with big slaughter, so tay 500,000 chosen men of Israel fall dead.
So Israel pikin dem lose for dat time, and Judah pikin dem win, because dem trust di Lord, di God of dem papa dem.
Abijah chase Jeroboam and take cities from am: Bethel with im towns, Jeshanah with im towns and Ephron with im towns.
Jeroboam no get strength again for Abijah days, and di Lord strike am, and e die.
But Abijah grow strong and marry 14 wives, and e born 22 sons and 16 daughters.
Di rest of wetin Abijah do, and im ways and im words, dem write dem for di commentary of Iddo di prophet.
So Abijah die join im papa dem, and dem bury am for David city, and im pikin Asa rule for im place. For im days di land dey quiet ten years.
Asa do wetin good and right for di eyes of di Lord im God,
because e remove di foreign altars and di high places, break di pillars and cut down di Asherah poles,
and command Judah to look for di Lord, di God of dem papa dem, and to do di law and di command.
E remove di high places and di incense altars from all di cities of Judah too, and di kingdom dey quiet before am.
E build strong cities for Judah, because di land dey quiet, and war no dey for am for dem years, because di Lord don give am rest.

Because e talk to Judah say, “Make we build dis cities and make walls round dem, with towers, gates and bars. Di land still dey before us, because we don look for di Lord our God. We don look for am, and e don give us rest for every side.” So dem build and prosper.
Asa get army of men wey carry small shields and spears, from Judah 300,000, and from Benjamin, wey carry shields and draw bows, 280,000. All dis ones na brave and mighty men.
Zerah di Ethiopian come out against dem with army of 1,000,000 and 300 chariots, and e come to Mareshah.
Den Asa go out to meet am, and dem arrange battle for di valley of Zephathah for Mareshah.

Asa cry to di Lord im God and talk say, “Di Lord, nobody dey except you to help, between di mighty and di one wey no get strength. Help us, di Lord our God, because we trust you, and for your name we don come against dis big crowd. Di Lord, you be our God. No let man win against you.”
So di Lord strike di Ethiopians before Asa and before Judah, and di Ethiopians run.

Asa and di people wey dey with am chase dem reach Gerar, and di Ethiopians fall so tay dem no fit recover, because dem destroy dem before di Lord and before im army. Dem carry plenty plenty things away.
Dem strike all di cities round Gerar, because di fear of di Lord come on dem. Dem carry things from all di cities, because plenty things dey inside dem.
Dem strike di tents of dem wey get cattle too, and carry plenty sheep and camels away, and return go Jerusalem.
God Spirit come on Azariah, Oded pikin,

and e go out to meet Asa and talk to am say, “Hear me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin. Di Lord dey with una as una dey with am, and if una look for am, una go find am, but if una leave am, e go leave una.
For long time Israel no get di true God, and no get priest wey dey teach, and no get law,
but as dem dey for trouble, dem turn to di Lord, di God of Israel, and look for am, and dem find am.
For dat time no peace dey for di one wey go out or come in, but big troubles dey on all di people wey dey stay for di lands.
Dem break dem to pieces, nation against nation and city against city, because God trouble dem with all kind of trouble.
But una be strong, and no let una hands weak, because dem go reward una work.”

As Asa hear dis words and di prophecy of Oded di prophet, e take courage and remove di disgusting idols from all di land of Judah and Benjamin and from di cities wey e take from Ephraim hill country, and e repair di altar of di Lord wey dey before di porch of di Lord.
E gather all Judah and Benjamin, and di people wey dey stay with dem from Ephraim, Manasseh and Simeon, because plenty fall to am from Israel as dem see say di Lord im God dey with am.
So dem gather for Jerusalem for di third month, for di 15th year of Asa rule.
Dem make sacrifice to di Lord for dat day from di things wey dem carry come, 700 cattle and 7,000 sheep.
Dem enter covenant to look for di Lord, di God of dem papa dem, with all dem heart and with all dem soul,
and say anybody wey no look for di Lord, di God of Israel, dem go kill am, small or big, man or woman.
Dem swear to di Lord with loud voice, with shouting, with trumpets and with horns.
All Judah rejoice because of di oath, because dem swear with all dem heart and look for am with all dem desire, and dem find am, and di Lord give dem rest for every side.
E remove Maacah too, im mama, from to be queen, because e make disgusting image for Asherah, and Asa cut down im image, grind am to powder and burn am for Kidron brook.
But dem no remove di high places from Israel. Still, Asa heart dey perfect all im days.
E bring enter God house di things wey im papa don give to God, and di things wey e imself give to God, silver, and gold, and vessels.
War no dey again till di 35th year of Asa rule.
For di 36th year of Asa rule, Baasha king of Israel go up against Judah and build Ramah, so that nobody go fit go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.
Den Asa bring out silver and gold from di treasures of di Lord house and of di king house and send am to Ben Hadad king of Syria, wey dey stay for Damascus, say,
“Treaty dey between me and you, as e dey between my papa and your papa. Look, I don send silver and gold to you. Go break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel, so that e go leave me.”
Ben Hadad listen to King Asa and send di captains of im armies against di cities of Israel, and dem strike Ijon, Dan, Abel Maim and all di store cities of Naphtali.
As Baasha hear am, e stop to build Ramah and make im work stop.
Den King Asa take all Judah, and dem carry away di stones of Ramah and di wood wey Baasha use build, and e use dem build Geba and Mizpah.

For dat time Hanani di seer come to Asa king of Judah and talk to am say, “Because you trust di king of Syria and you no trust di Lord your God, so di army of di king of Syria don escape from your hand.
Di Ethiopians and di Lubim no be big army, with chariots and plenty horsemen? Still, because you trust di Lord, e give dem into your hand.

Because di eyes of di Lord dey run go and come for all di earth, to show imself strong for dem wey get perfect heart toward am. You don do foolish thing for dis one, because from now you go get wars.”
Den Asa vex with di seer and put am for prison, because e dey very vex with am because of dis thing. Asa press some of di people for di same time.
Look, di acts of Asa, from first to last, look, dem write dem for di book of di kings of Judah and Israel.
For di 39th year of im rule Asa get sickness for im feet. Im sickness big well well, but for im sickness e no look for di Lord, but for di physicians.
Asa die join im papa dem and die for di 41st year of im rule.

Dem bury am for im own tomb, wey e cut for imself for David city, and dem lay am for di bed wey full of sweet smell and different kinds of spices wey perfumers prepare, and dem make very big fire for am.
Jehoshaphat im pikin rule for im place and make imself strong against Israel.
E put soldiers for all di strong cities of Judah, and put garrisons for Judah land and for di cities of Ephraim wey im papa Asa don take.
Di Lord dey with Jehoshaphat, because e waka for di first ways of im papa David and no look for di Baals,
but e look for di God of im papa and waka for im commands, and no follow wetin Israel dey do.
So di Lord make di kingdom stand for im hand, and all Judah bring tribute to Jehoshaphat, and e get riches and honor plenty plenty.
Im heart lift up for di ways of di Lord, and e remove di high places and di Asherah poles from Judah too.
For di third year of im rule e send im princes, Ben Hail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel and Micaiah, to teach for di cities of Judah,
and with dem di Levites, Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah and Tobadonijah, di Levites, and with dem Elishama and Jehoram, di priests.
Dem teach for Judah, with di book of di law of di Lord with dem, and dem go round all di cities of Judah and teach among di people.
Di fear of di Lord fall on all di kingdoms of di lands wey dey round Judah, so tay dem no fight against Jehoshaphat.
Some of di Philistines bring Jehoshaphat gifts and tribute silver. Di Arabians bring am flocks too, 7,700 rams and 7,700 male goats.
Jehoshaphat grow very great, and e build for Judah strong places and store cities.
E get plenty works for di cities of Judah, and men of war, brave and mighty men, for Jerusalem.
Dis na dem number according to dem papa dem houses: from Judah, di captains of thousands, Adnah di chief, and with am brave and mighty men 300,000,
and next to am Jehohanan di captain, and with am 280,000,
and next to am Amasiah, Zichri pikin, wey give imself willingly to di Lord, and with am 200,000 brave and mighty men.
From Benjamin: Eliada, brave and mighty man, and with am 200,000 wey carry bow and shield,
and next to am Jehozabad, and with am 180,000 wey ready for war.
Dis ones na di ones wey dey serve di king, apart from di ones wey di king put for di strong cities for all Judah.
Now Jehoshaphat get riches and honor plenty plenty, and e join family with Ahab.
After some years e go down to Ahab for Samaria. Ahab kill sheep and oxen for am plenty plenty, and for di people wey dey with am, and e push am to go up with am to Ramoth Gilead.
Ahab king of Israel talk to Jehoshaphat king of Judah say, “You go go with me to Ramoth Gilead?” E answer am say, “I be like you, and my people like your people, and we go dey with you for di war.”
Jehoshaphat talk to di king of Israel say, “I beg, first ask for di word of di Lord.”
Den di king of Israel gather di prophets, 400 men, and talk to dem say, “Make we go to Ramoth Gilead for battle, or make I hold back?” Dem talk say, “Go up, because God go give am into di king hand.”
But Jehoshaphat talk say, “Prophet of di Lord no dey here again, so that we go ask am?”

Di king of Israel talk to Jehoshaphat say, “One man still dey wey we fit use ask di Lord, but I hate am, because e no dey prophesy good about me, but evil all di time. Na Micaiah, Imla pikin.” Jehoshaphat talk say, “Make di king no talk so.”
Di king of Israel call one officer and talk say, “Bring Micaiah, Imla pikin, quick quick.”

Di king of Israel and Jehoshaphat di king of Judah dey sit, each one for im throne, wear dem royal clothes, for open place for di entrance of di gate of Samaria, and all di prophets dey prophesy before dem.
Zedekiah, Chenaanah pikin, make iron horns for imself and talk say, “Dis na wetin di Lord talk: ‘With dis ones you go push Syria until dem finish.’”
All di prophets prophesy so say, “Go up to Ramoth Gilead and prosper, because di Lord go give am into di king hand.”
Di messenger wey go call Micaiah talk to am say, “Look, di words of di prophets dey talk good for di king with one mouth. I beg, make your word be like di word of one of dem, and talk wetin good.”
Micaiah talk say, “As di Lord dey alive, wetin my God talk, na dat I go talk.”
As e reach di king, di king talk to am say, “Micaiah, make we go to Ramoth Gilead for battle, or make I hold back?” E answer say, “Go up and prosper, and dem go give dem into your hand.”
Di king talk to am say, “How many times I go make you swear say you go talk only truth to me for di name of di Lord?”
E talk say, “I see all Israel scatter for di mountains, like sheep wey no get shepherd. Di Lord talk say, ‘Dis people no get oga. Make each one return to im house in peace.’”
Di king of Israel talk to Jehoshaphat say, “I no tell you say e no go prophesy good about me, but evil?”
Micaiah talk say, “So hear di word of di Lord. I see di Lord dey sit for im throne, and all di army of heaven dey stand for im right hand and for im left.
Di Lord talk say, ‘Who go deceive Ahab king of Israel, so that e go go up and fall for Ramoth Gilead?’ One talk one thing, another talk another thing.
Den one spirit come out, stand before di Lord and talk say, ‘I go deceive am.’ Di Lord talk to am say, ‘How?’
E talk say, ‘I go go out and be lying spirit for di mouth of all im prophets.’ Di Lord talk say, ‘You go deceive am, and you go win too. Go out and do so.’
So now, look, di Lord don put lying spirit for di mouth of dis your prophets, and di Lord don talk evil about you.”
Den Zedekiah, Chenaanah pikin, come near and slap Micaiah for face and talk say, “Which way di Spirit of di Lord pass from me to talk to you?”
Micaiah talk say, “Look, you go see for dat day, as you go enter inside room to hide yourself.”
Di king of Israel talk say, “Take Micaiah and carry am go back to Amon di governor of di city and to Joash di king pikin,
and talk say, ‘Dis na wetin di king talk: “Put dis man for prison and feed am with di bread of suffering and di water of suffering until I return in peace.”’”
Micaiah talk say, “If you return in peace at all, di Lord no talk by me.” E talk say, “Hear, una peoples, all of una.”
So di king of Israel and Jehoshaphat di king of Judah go up to Ramoth Gilead.
Di king of Israel talk to Jehoshaphat say, “I go change how I look and enter di battle, but you wear your royal clothes.” Di king of Israel change how e look and dem enter di battle.
Now di king of Syria don command di captains of im chariots say, “No fight with small or big, except only with di king of Israel.”
As di captains of di chariots see Jehoshaphat, dem talk say, “Na di king of Israel.” So dem turn to fight against am, but Jehoshaphat cry out, and di Lord help am, and God move dem from am.
As di captains of di chariots see say no be di king of Israel, dem turn back from chasing am.

One man draw im bow anyhow and strike di king of Israel between di joints of di armor. So e talk to di driver of im chariot say, “Turn round and carry me out of di battle, because dem don wound me bad.”
Di battle increase dat day, and di king of Israel prop imself up for im chariot against di Syrians till evening, and as di sun dey go down, e die.
